title: 第十四章 吸掌
content_zh:
听着在心中响起的声音，萧炎双眼轻微的眨了眨，不着痕迹的点点下巴 。
并没有立即拿起那块黑色铁片，萧炎轻抛了抛手中沾有血丝的绿色魔晶，冲着摊贩后的那一位看上去有些贼眉鼠眼的佣兵男子笑道：“这是哪种魔兽的魔晶”
“嘿嘿，少爷好眼力，这是一阶魔兽吞木狐的魔晶，在一阶魔晶中，这可算是极品了，为了获得这枚魔晶，我们尖牙佣兵团，可足足守了三天，杀了五只吞木狐，才得到这么一枚”见到萧炎衣着不凡，那名佣兵男子赶忙殷切的介绍道 。
“如果少爷看上了的话，只需要五百金币就好，嘿嘿，为了猎杀吞木狐，我们还有几个兄弟受了不轻的伤”
萧炎手指搽了搽魔晶上的血丝，果然发现血丝还未完全凝固，微微点了点头，瞟了一眼对方胸口上的两枚金星，随意的道：“贵了，一般一级魔晶的价格，只在四百到四百五左右，而且吞木狐虽然也是魔兽，不过攻击力却不太高，你的那些队员，不会连斗者级别都没达到吧”
嘴角抽了抽，佣兵男子干笑了两声，显然没想到面前这少年竟然对市价和魔兽如此了解，当下只得讪笑道：“四百七吧，不能再少了，毕竟我们兄弟也得生活不是”
“唉”在佣兵男子忐忑的目光中叹了一口气，萧炎弯下身子，在摊铺上一阵乱抓，刚好那古怪的铁片也在其中，扬了扬手中的一把东西：“四百七，一起吧”
眼睛在萧炎手中的物品上刁钻的移过，佣兵男子悄悄的松了一口气，还好都是便宜东西
爽快的丢出一小袋金币，萧炎二话不说，拿起东西转身就走
“嘿，小炎子，不错嘛，买个东西还这么小心翼翼。”转身的霎那，药老在心中戏谑的笑着 。
“这些家伙都是奸商，只要一看见你对什么东西表现了喜欢的举动，那就拍了马的加价，我可不想当冤大头”在心中平淡的回了一句，萧炎也不再管戒指中古怪的老头，陪着薰儿，悠闲的逛出坊市，然后慢慢的回到了家族之中
与薰儿在家族中分开了手，萧炎心急火燎的窜回了自己的屋子，然后谨慎的关好门窗
回过头，望着那不知何时出来的药老，萧炎从怀中掏出所购买的药物与魔晶，有些急切的道：“东西都搞到了，还要怎么弄”
药老嘿嘿一笑，目光随意的扫了扫桌上的材料，忽然道：“你不看看那黑铁片么”
“呃”萧炎一愣，旋即又赶忙掏出那枚黑铁片，上上下下仔细的看了一遍，皱眉道：“这东西，干什么的”
药老顺手接过铁片，笑道：“这里面，似乎存了一种斗技，不过制造铁片的人或许也是一位炼药师，所以，这铁片，只有灵魂感知力过人的人才能感应到。”
“斗技”闻言，萧炎眼睛一亮，急忙问道：“什么级别的”
斗技在斗气大陆之上，其重视程度，丝毫不比斗气功法小，一门高深的斗技，能够让人在战斗之时，发挥出远超自身的强横力量 。
斗技和功法一般，也分天地玄黄四阶，流传在大陆公众阶层的斗技，顶多只是黄阶高级左右，一些高等级的斗技，只能去一些学院或者宗派，才有可能获得 。
当然，斗气大陆辽阔之极，总有一些前人的斗技，因为种种缘故，失传遗落，最后被某幸运人所得，而现在萧炎所得到的黑铁片，或许便是一位前人所遗留而下的吧

药老翻了翻铁片，片刻后方才笑道：“吸掌：玄阶低级”
“玄阶低级”小脸微喜，萧炎没想到这随意买来的破烂货，竟然还隐藏了一个玄阶的斗技，要知道，自己家族中，最高深的斗技，也不过才是玄阶中级，而且那还只有族长以及几位长老有资格学习 。
“吸掌：炼至大成，可吸千斤巨石，若是遇敌，狂猛吸力，能将人体血液，强行扯出”
“将血液扯出体内”脸庞一惊，萧炎咽了口唾沫，有些惊异的道：“这太牛了吧血液若是离了体，谁还能活下来”
“这东西当然只能对付等级比你低或者相同的对手，若是遇到比你还强的，人家直接借力近身，倒霉的，还是你”药老将铁片随意的丢了过来，淡淡的道，看来他对这斗技的评价并不高 。
药老是大人物，自然眼界高，可在萧炎眼中，这可是高级斗技啊，当下乐不可支的拿起黑铁片，笑道：“不管怎么样，这吸掌总比家族中那些普通斗技要好许多，以后，就学它了”
“嗤，就你那三段斗之气，能吸起一根树枝就很了不起了，还想吸人血”摇了摇头，药老撇嘴道 。
翻了翻白眼，萧炎也懒得理会这古怪的老头，自己抱着铁片嘿嘿发笑 。
“瞧你那模样，一个玄阶低级的斗技就把你迷成这样，真是丢人”无奈的摇了摇头，药老抓起桌上的魔晶，对着萧炎吩咐道：“去弄一大盆水来。”
瞧着药老似乎是要开工了，萧炎赶紧收好黑铁片，屁颠屁颠的去准备了
安静的房间之中，药老左手拿起紫叶兰草，眼睛微微眯起，片刻之后，轻轻的吐了一口气，左掌之上，有些显白的火焰，忽然猛的腾了出来
火焰刚刚出现，房间之中，温度便是上升了许多 。
眼睛眨也不眨的盯着那团白色火焰，萧炎心头有些震撼，虽然他并清楚炼药师的炼药流程，可这斗气外放，化成实质，就算是自己的父亲，那也不可能办到啊
脸色淡然，药老手中的白色火焰略微扑腾，将那株紫叶兰草吞噬其中火焰在翻腾，紫叶兰草几乎是在瞬间，便是被烧成了一小团绿色的液体
右手再次抓起一株紫叶兰草，直接丢进白色火焰之中
将三株紫叶兰草全部丢进之后，那团绿色液体，明显变得大了许多 。
绿色液体，在火焰之中不断蠕动，炽热的温度，一刻不停的煅烧着其中的杂质
随着火焰的煅烧，绿色液体越来越来小，片刻后，竟然便只剩下了拇指大小左右
接下来，药老又将两株洗骨花，投进了火焰之中，将它们在煅烧之后，融进了绿色液体之中
再接下来，便是炼化魔晶

三个步骤，足足持续了一个小时左右，而药老的脸色，却依旧精神抖擞，没有半点疲累之感 。
一个小时之后，坚硬的魔晶，已经被煅烧成了一团淡绿液体，魔晶中所蕴含的狂暴能量，也被药老以神奇的药性配合，洗刷而去
手掌中，白色火焰逐渐消退，最后完全的消失 。
望着药老手心处悬浮的一滴宛如翡翠般颜色的液体，萧炎搓了搓手，过人的灵魂感知力，让得他清楚的感应到这液体拥有多么充沛的能量
“老师，就这么服下它么”萧炎眨了眨眼，有些迫不及待 。
“想死就直接服下吧，凭你那副脉络，马上就得变成真正的废物。”白了萧炎一眼，药老屈指轻弹，翡翠液体落进了房中的那盆清水之中，顿时，一盆清澈的水，便是化成了青色 。
“以后，就在这里面修炼，以你的修炼天赋，一年之内，达到七段，不是什么难事。”药老拍了拍手，微笑道 。
萧炎满心欢喜，急忙点头 。
“哦，差点忘记了，这种药水，只能持续两个月，也就是说，你每隔两个月，就还要去购买一次今天的这些东西。”药老笑吟吟的道 。
小脸一僵，萧炎有点哭丧的点了点头 。
“，这东西果然只有有钱人才用得起”
content_en:
Listening to the voice that sounded in his heart, Xiao Yan blinked his eyes slightly and tapped his chin without any trace.
Xiao Yan did not immediately pick up the black piece of iron. He lightly tossed the blood-stained green magic crystal in his hand and smiled at the mercenary man behind the vendor who looked a bit sinister. "What kind of magic crystal is this?"
"Hey, young master, you have good eyesight. This is the magic crystal of the first-order magic beast Wood-Eating Fox. Among the first-order magic crystals, this is considered the best. In order to obtain this magic crystal, our fang mercenary group guarded for three days and killed five wood-eating foxes before we got such one." Seeing Xiao Yan's extraordinary clothes, the mercenary man introduced it eagerly.
"If the young master likes it, all it takes is five hundred gold coins. Hehe, several of our brothers were seriously injured in order to hunt down the wood-swallowing fox."
Xiao Yan rubbed the blood threads on the magic crystal with his fingers, and found that the blood threads had not completely solidified. He nodded slightly, glanced at the two gold stars on the opponent's chest, and said casually: "It's expensive. Generally, the price of first-level magic crystals is only around 400 to 450. And although the Wood-Tumbling Fox is also a Warcraft, its attack power is not very high. Those of your team members have not even reached the fighter level, right?"
The corner of his mouth twitched, and the mercenary man laughed twice. He obviously didn't expect that the young man in front of him knew so much about market prices and Warcraft. He could only laugh and said: "Four hundred and seven, no more, after all, we brothers also have to live, right?"
"Alas" Xiao Yan sighed under the anxious gaze of the mercenary man. He bent down and scratched at the pavement. The strange iron piece happened to be among them. He raised a handful of things in his hand and said, "Four hundred and seven, let's get together."
His eyes moved carefully over the items in Xiao Yan's hands, and the mercenary man breathed a sigh of relief. Fortunately, they were all cheap items.
Xiao Yan happily threw out a small bag of gold coins. Without saying a word, Xiao Yan picked up the things and turned around to leave.
"Hey, Xiao Yanzi, it's not bad, you are so careful when buying something." The moment he turned around, Yao Lao smiled jokingly in his heart.
"These guys are all profiteers. As soon as they see you showing interest in something, they will charge a higher price. I don't want to be taken advantage of." He replied calmly in his heart. Xiao Yan no longer cared about the weird old man in the ring. He accompanied Xun'er and strolled leisurely through the market, and then slowly returned to the family.
After parting ways with Xun'er in the family, Xiao Yan rushed back to his house anxiously, and then carefully closed the doors and windows.
Turning back and looking at the Yao Lao who had come out at an unknown time, Xiao Yan took out the medicine and magic crystal he had purchased from his arms and said with some urgency: "I've got everything, what else can I do?"
Yao Lao chuckled, glanced at the materials on the table casually, and suddenly said: "Don't you look at the black iron piece?"
"Uh" Xiao Yan was stunned for a moment, then quickly took out the black iron piece, looked at it carefully up and down, and frowned: "What is this thing for?"
Yao Lao took the iron piece smoothly and said with a smile: "There seems to be a kind of fighting skill in it, but the person who made the iron piece may also be an alchemist, so this iron piece can only be sensed by people with extraordinary soul perception."
"Fighting Skills" Hearing this, Xiao Yan's eyes lit up and he hurriedly asked: "What level?"
Fighting skills are on the Dou Qi Continent, and their importance is no less than that of Dou Qi Kung Fu. A profound fighting skill can allow people to exert tyrannical power that far exceeds their own when fighting.
Fighting skills and techniques are generally divided into four levels of heaven, earth, black and yellow. The fighting skills spread among the public in mainland China are at most around the upper level of the yellow level. Some high-level fighting skills can only be obtained by going to some academies or sects.
Of course, the Dou Qi Continent is extremely vast, and there are always some fighting skills of the predecessors. Due to various reasons, they were lost and left behind, and were finally obtained by a lucky person. And the black iron piece Xiao Yan obtained now may be a person.It's something left over from our predecessors, right?
Yao Lao turned over the iron piece, and after a moment he smiled and said: "Sucking palm: low level of Xuan level"
"Low-level Xuan-level" face was slightly happy. Xiao Yan did not expect that this random piece of junk would actually hide a Xuan-level fighting skill. You must know that the most advanced fighting skill in his family is only at the intermediate level of Xuan-level, and only the clan leader and a few elders are qualified to learn it.
"Suction Palm: When refined to perfection, it can absorb a thousand kilograms of boulders. If it encounters an enemy, the fierce suction force can forcefully pull out the blood of a human body."
"Tear the blood out of the body." His face was shocked. Xiao Yan swallowed and said with some surprise: "This is so awesome. If the blood leaves the body, who can survive?"
"Of course, this thing can only deal with opponents who are lower than you or the same level. If you encounter someone stronger than you, they will directly use their strength to get close. You will be the unlucky one." Yao Laojiang casually threw the iron piece over and said calmly. It seems that he did not think highly of this fighting skill.
Yao Lao is a big shot and naturally has a high vision, but in Xiao Yan's eyes, this is an advanced fighting skill. He picked up the black iron piece with joy and said with a smile: "No matter what, this palm sucking is much better than the ordinary fighting skills in the family. I will learn it from now on."
"Hey, with your three levels of fighting spirit, it's amazing that you can suck up a branch. You also want to suck human blood." Shaking his head, Yao Lao curled his lips and said.
Rolling his eyes, Xiao Yan didn't bother to pay attention to this weird old man, and laughed while holding the iron piece.
"Look at your appearance. It's really embarrassing that a low-level fighting skill at the Xuan level can confuse you like this." Shaking his head helplessly, Yao Lao grabbed the magic crystal on the table and ordered Xiao Yan: "Go get a big basin of water."
Seeing that Yao Lao seemed to be starting work, Xiao Yan quickly put away the black iron pieces and went to get ready.
In the quiet room, Yao Lao picked up the purple-leaf orchid with his left hand, narrowed his eyes slightly, and after a moment, he breathed out gently, and some white flames suddenly shot out on his left palm.
As soon as the flame appeared, the temperature in the room rose a lot.
Staring at the white flame without blinking, Xiao Yan was a little shocked. Although he did not know the alchemist's refining process, it was impossible for even his father to release his fighting spirit and turn it into substance.
With a calm expression on his face, the white flame in Yao Lao's hand flickered slightly, swallowing up the purple orchid grass. The flames were churning, and the purple orchid grass was burned into a small ball of green liquid almost instantly.
He grabbed another purple-leaf orchid with his right hand and threw it directly into the white flames.
After throwing all three purple-leaf orchid plants in, the green liquid became obviously much larger.
The green liquid is constantly squirming in the flames, and the hot temperature is constantly burning the impurities in it.
As the flame burned, the green liquid became smaller and smaller. After a while, it was only about the size of a thumb.
Next, Yaolao threw two more bone-washing flowers into the flames, and after calcining them, they melted into the green liquid.
The next step is to refine the magic crystal
The three steps lasted for about an hour, but Yao Lao's face was still full of energy and did not feel tired at all.
An hour later, the hard magic crystal had been calcined into a ball of light green liquid. The violent energy contained in the magic crystal was also washed away by Yao Lao's magical medicinal properties.
In the palm of the hand, the white flame gradually faded and finally disappeared completely.
Looking at the drop of jade-like liquid floating in the palm of Yao Lao's hand, Xiao Yan rubbed his hands. His extraordinary soul perception allowed him to clearly sense how much energy this liquid had.
"Teacher, are you just going to take it?" Xiao Yan blinked, a little impatient.
"If you want to die, just take it. With your veins, you will become a real waste in no time." Xiao Yan said indifferently.Eyes, Yaolao flicked his fingers, and the emerald liquid fell into the basin of clear water in the room. Suddenly, the basin of clear water turned into cyan.
"From now on, you will practice here. With your talent in cultivation, it will not be difficult to reach the seventh level within a year." Yao Lao clapped his hands and said with a smile.
Xiao Yan was filled with joy and nodded hurriedly.
"Oh, I almost forgot, this potion can only last for two months, which means that you have to buy these things today every two months." Yao Lao said with a smile.
Xiao Yan's face froze, and Xiao Yan nodded sadly.
"Sure enough, only rich people can afford this thing."
